summary: Barona Group of Capitan Grande Band of Mission Indians Land Transfer Act of 2026 This bill takes three parcels of specified federal land (approximately 847 acres) in San Diego County, California, into trust for the benefit of the Barona Group of Capitan Grande Band of Mission Indians of the Barona Reservation, California. The land taken into trust shall be part of the Tribe's reservation. One parcel (approximately 164 acres) is currently administered by the Bureau of Land Management (BLM), and two parcels (approximately 683 acres) are currently administered by the Forest Service. Administrative jurisdiction over the Forest Service land must be transferred to the Department of the Interior.
